map.如何使用乒乓对战？: How do I use Pong Battle?
map.乒乓对战适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Pong Battle best for?
map.经典 Pong 游戏，支持双人对战和 AI 模式，先得 11 分获胜: Classic Pong game with two-player and AI modes; first to 11 points wins
map.乒乓对战（Pong）是最早的电子游戏之一，现在以纯前端技术重新呈现。: Pong is one of the earliest video games, now recreated with pure frontend technology.
map.双方各控制一个挡板，将球击向对方: Each side controls a paddle to hit the ball toward the opponent
map.球从上/下边界反弹，从左/右边界出界则对方得分: The ball bounces off top/bottom edges; if it exits the left/right edge, the opponent scores
map.球击中挡板不同位置会改变反弹角度: Hitting the ball at different paddle positions changes the bounce angle
map.先得 11 分的一方获胜: The first side to 11 points wins
map.电脑自动控制右挡板: The computer auto-controls the right paddle
map.AI 有反应延迟和移动误差: The AI has reaction delay and movement error
map.球速越快 AI 越容易失误: The faster the ball, the more the AI tends to miss
map.每次击球后球速略微增加: The ball speeds up slightly after each hit
map.回合越长节奏越紧张: The longer the rally, the tenser the pace
map.球速显示在信息栏中: Ball speed shows in the info bar
map.在画布左半区域上下滑动控制左板: Swipe up/down on the left half of the canvas to control the left paddle
map.在画布右半区域上下滑动控制右板: Swipe up/down on the right half to control the right paddle
map.双人对战：同屏左右挡板，接球对打。: Two-player: left/right paddles on the same screen, rally back and forth.
map.AI 模式：单人挑战电脑，难度可调。: AI mode: challenge the computer solo, with adjustable difficulty.
map.休闲竞技：先得目标分（默认 11）者胜。: Casual competition: first to the target score (default 11) wins.
map.双方用挡板接住来回的球，漏接对方得分；先达到目标分（默认 11 分，可设）者胜。: Both sides use paddles to catch the rallying ball; a miss gives the opponent a point. First to the target score (default 11, adjustable) wins. Ball speed creeps up with rallies, and AI difficulty is adjustable.
map.玩家先到 11 分、对手 8 分 → 玩家胜；若中途连续漏接被对手连得 3 分则: Player reaches 11, opponent 8 → player wins; but if you miss several in a row and the opponent scores 3 straight, you could be overtaken. Controlling paddle angle (edge hits change the exit angle) is key to defense and counterattack.
map.目标分固定 11 吗？: Is the target score fixed at 11?
map.默认 11，可调；正式乒乓比赛也是 11 分制（领先 2 分胜）。: Default 11, adjustable; official table tennis also uses 11 points (win by 2).
map.怎么打赢 AI？: How do I beat the AI?
map.用挡板边缘接球改变球路，逼 AI 够不到；AI 弱时直接对拉消耗。: Use the paddle edge to change the ball path and make the AI miss; when the AI is weak, just rally to wear it down.
map.经典乒乓对战游戏，支持双人对战和AI模式。纯前端Canvas渲染，无需安装，即开: Classic Pong battle with two-player and AI modes. Pure-frontend Canvas rendering, no install, play instantly. First to 11 wins, ball speed rises with rallies. A casual game tool—no install, playable offline.
